scope: Primary-source and exact-example reuse review; reference decision with no enabled adapter
limitations: No native R/TFP engine execution or qualified adapter.
Complete compatible environment and transitive dependency/notice inventory remain future work.
No causal-assumption verification, bank returns or independent acceptance.
revisit_trigger: Compatible pinned R environment plus complete intended-build dependency/notice inventory, matched native behavior oracle and inspected conversion/failure results; re-review on scientific scope, source revision or platform change.

criteria.finding: Exact R pin, package/dependency license declarations, maintenance/test intent and distinct TFP/aGrUM identities are bound. Unresolved build closure is explicitly deferred rather than borrowed from Apache package terms.
Target/uncertainty meanings, costs, owner duties, alternatives and revisit triggers are developed in the decision and six printed pages. Exact examples reproduce the limits.

Reference disposition grants no integration_allowed; a future isolated R adapter requires a compatible pinned build, matched native oracle and conversion/failure review. The proposed contract is explicit, not implemented behavior.
